milestones.description_en: Red Point Sdn Bhd was established in Kuching, Sarawak, with a clear purpose: to combine the judgment of traditional media with the speed and expression of new media.
milestones.description_zh: Red Point Sdn Bhd 于 2023 年创立于砂拉越古晋，取传统媒体的判断与责任，融合新媒体的速度、视觉语言与平台思维。

milestones.title_zh: 从 3 人成长至 15 人。
milestones.description_en: Between 2024 and 2025, the team grew from three people to fifteen, extending its capabilities across Chinese and English media, creative production, social content, automotive and technology.
milestones.description_zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，团队从最初的 3 人逐步扩张至 15 人，业务延伸至华文与英文资讯、创意制作、社交内容，以及汽车与科技领域。

milestones.title_zh: 立足古晋，拓展更多地区。
milestones.description_en: In 2026, Red Point continues to deepen its work in Kuching and Sarawak while developing business, client and partnership opportunities in other parts of Malaysia.
milestones.description_zh: 2026 年，Red Point 除了持续深耕古晋与砂拉越，也开始积极发展其他地区的业务、客户与合作网络。

milestones.label: 2027 TARGET
milestones.title_en: Across Malaysia, with the story still unfolding.
milestones.title_zh: 走向全马，继续发扬品牌神话。
milestones.description_en: Our 2027 target is to grow the business across Malaysia, building a stronger network for brands, audiences and creative partners while carrying the Red Point story forward.
milestones.description_zh: 2027 年的目标，是将业务发展至全马，建立更完整的品牌、受众与创意伙伴网络，继续发扬属于 Red Point 的品牌故事。
